description.label: Description
description.value:
Novice: Followers of this path are considered immortal. Your fists feel as hard as iron, breaking through stone and armor with ease. Your Unarmed Attacks gain the Pummeling Weapon Quality.

Apprentice: Add an additional +1 Damage to your Unarmed Attacks. (raising the maximum bonus to SB+6)

Journeyman: Your Arms and Legs gain +2 Armor Points;

moreover, you gain the +1 Resistance (Stun) Talent.

Master: Gain the Strike to Stun Talent when using your Unarmed attacks.
